run_prepare_sn_data: run the script to prepare speech normalizer data from an audio directory into TSV and unit files
run_prepare_sn_inference: run the script with --for-inference to prepare audio data for speech normalizer inference
run_prepare_sn_training: run the script with --target-unit to prepare audio data with unit sequences for training
review_process_function: review the process function that generates TSV manifests and unit files from audio directories
refactor_process_function: refactor the process function to support additional audio formats or unit processing modes
